name: OPT-NC DC Nouville
notes: Official OPT-NC release says the DC Nouville site hosts the data center, accounts for 4.5% of OPT-NC electricity consumption, and received 276 solar panels totaling 124 kWp; DCD independently reported the same operational site. No IT load disclosed.

name: DSP DC1-MGTA
notes: DSP states it is based in Noumea and operates two data centers in New Caledonia. Its service brochure identifies the first site as DC1-MGTA, dedicated to production; Data Center Map lists DSP DC1 at 210 rue Gervolino with 20 racks. No MW capacity disclosed.

name: DSP DC2-GAL
notes: DSP's brochure identifies the second site as DC2-GAL for PRA/PCA disaster-recovery services; Data Center Map lists DSP DC2 at 34 rue du general Gallieni with 6 racks. No MW capacity disclosed.

name: UNC/CRESICA shared computing data center
notes: OPT-NC reported that the University of New Caledonia's PNT had been operational since the 2019 academic year and that a data center/server room had been installed at UNC with high-performance computing servers being installed; OPT-NC sponsored a 10 Gbps leased link between UNC Nouville and IRD Ansa Vata. No MW capacity disclosed.

name: Stratos Noumea Tier 3+ data center
notes: Stratos markets a local Noumea Tier 3/Tier 3+ infrastructure for sovereign cloud, server hosting, backup, and managed services, with 99.98% availability claims and local NC data residency. Source pages are operator-owned; no MW capacity disclosed.

name: Exodata Noumea data center
notes: Exodata's cloud page lists its Noumea, New Caledonia data center for local cloud presence in the South Pacific; a 2022 company post says Exodata had operated in Noumea since 2017 and acquired myCloud, described as a datacenter-autonomous specialist. No MW capacity disclosed.

name: my::NET New Caledonia interconnected data centers
notes: OPEN NC profile says my::NET, founded in 2018, operates three interconnected data centers 100% in New Caledonia for sovereign cloud/IaaS/SaaS/PaaS, storage, backup, virtualization, compute, and cybersecurity. Facility names and MW capacity not disclosed.

name: ART Cloud localized IBM data center
notes: ART Informatique markets ART Cloud hosting in New Caledonia in a localized IBM data center of level 3+ with stated availability above 99.98%. The page does not identify a separate facility address or MW capacity.

name: Felix Datacenter
notes: Open-map-derived listings identify Felix Datacenter at 5 Rue Felix Broche, Noumea, with Nautile as operator/owner and creation date shown as 2021-01-01. Treated as weak evidence because sources are map/aggregate listings rather than operator or permit records; no MW capacity disclosed.
